title: Mid-Term Evaluation — practice knowledge check
status: Draft practice quiz; teacher review required
instructions: Ten publicly answerable practice questions from the Course and Laboratory. Results remain only in your browser; not an official exam grade.

questions.prompt: You need to switch a fan on whenever temperature exceeds 26 °C. What's the simplest first solution?
questions.explanation: A precise deterministic rule needs no training data or learned model.

questions.prompt: You have delivery coordinates without any correct group labels. What is the relevant first learning method?
options: A language model as the only option
questions.explanation: K-means can group unlabelled spatial examples.

questions.prompt: In the digit recognition experiment, what is the target label?
questions.explanation: The target is which digit the image represents; 64 pixel values are features.

questions.prompt: What happens if a classifier uses the known test labels to choose nearest neighbours?
options: It gives a more independent test
It leaks answers into the model, invalidating independent evaluation
It makes the image physically larger
questions.explanation: Test labels may only be consulted after predictions for evaluation.

questions.prompt: With 196 correct and 4 incorrect out of 200 tests, what is the error rate?
On the same 200-image test subset, k=3 gets 196 correct and k=5 gets 195. How many percentage points separate their accuracies?
Where do incorrect predictions appear in a confusion matrix with actual labels as rows and predicted labels as columns?
options: They are excluded from the matrix
questions.explanation: The diagonal records a correct label. Off-diagonal counts show which labels are confused.

questions.prompt: Which information is necessary to reproduce the classroom classifier?
options: Dataset split, distance function, k and preprocessing
Only the name of the pupil
questions.explanation: Data, settings and evaluation procedure must be specified.

questions.prompt: Select ALL defensible statements about 196/200 correct results.
options: This score applies to the fixed held-out classroom subset
Every person's handwriting is now guaranteed readable
Four of these particular test digits were misclassified
The system has 98% confidence in every individual prediction
questions.explanation: Report the sample and denominator; do not generalise beyond the observed data.

options: Choose settings on validation data and reserve a final test set
Use the test answers to train the model, then claim independent accuracy
Publish only a percentage and hide the denominator
questions.explanation: Separating training, model selection and final evaluation reduces bias; honest error analysis matters.
